navaid.name: Bailey Bay Buoy
navaid.description: Available on a first-come, first-served basis and is intended for small and medium watercraft. It's located in water depths between 30 and 80 feet and marked by a white buoy with blue reflective tape. The buoy provides access to the Shelokum Lake Trail.
